goal: Make Isabel feel immediately responsive rather than like a queued avatar pipeline.
strategy: Stream every stage that can stream: ASR partials, LLM tokens, TTS audio, facial motion and screen updates.
Do not wait for a full transcript when intent is already stable enough for safe preparation.
Allow Isabel to begin nonverbal acknowledgement while the brain is still thinking.
Prefetch likely screen data and common office actions before speech finishes.
Keep local Unreal movement, gaze and animation decisions on the home AI PC.
Use barge-in as a first-class path, not an error case.
Never fake certainty to save latency; uncertain actions wait for confirmation while nonverbal behavior continues.
quality_rule: Perceived responsiveness matters more than raw benchmark speed. Isabel should acknowledge instantly, think visibly but subtly, and begin speaking as soon as useful audio is available.
